{"hypotheses": [
  {
    "name": "H1",
    "mechanism": "Firms with high bid-ask spread and high volume trading are more likely to see price manipulations during high VIX regimes, leading to mean-reversion in the following month.",
    "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "BidAskSpread"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "VolMkt"}], "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true},
    "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "STreversal", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}],
    "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7,
    "expected_decay_half_life_months": 24
  },
  {
    "name": "H2",
    "mechanism": "Companies with high stocks of intangible assets and organisational capital, are expected to perform better in positive market conditions due to their superior knowledge base and competitive positioning.",
    "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "OrgCap"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "IntanBM"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "vol_target": true},
    "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}],
    "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.65,
    "expected_decay_half_life_months": 36
  },
  {
    "name": "H3",
    "mechanism": "Firms marked by institutional ownership and high dividend payouts are likely to perform better when the term spread is positive, reflecting a healthier economic environment.",
    "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "IO_ShortInterest"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "PayoutYield"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "vol_target": true},
    "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "same_sign"}],
    "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.75,
    "expected_decay_half_life_months": 48
  },
  {
    "name": "H4",
    "mechanism": "Firms with high leverage and low book-to-market ratios are likely to underperform in poor market conditions due to increased financial distress costs.",
    "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Leverage"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "BM"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "vol_target": true},
    "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Beta", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}],
    "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8,
    "expected_decay_half_life_months": 18
  },
  {
    "name": "H5",
    "mechanism": "Firms with high earnings surprises and high analyst optimism are likely to perform better in low VIX regimes, reflecting stable market conditions.",
    "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "EarningsSurprise"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "AOP"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true},
    "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}],
    "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.85,
    "expected_decay_half_life_months": 12
  },
  {
    "name": "H6",
    "mechanism": "Companies with high dividend yield and active shareholders are expected to outperform when the term spread is positive, indicating a healthier economic environment.",
    "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "DivYieldST"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Activism2"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "vol_target": true},
    "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "same_sign"}],
    "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9,
    "expected_decay_half_life_months": 30
  },
  {
    "name": "H7",
    "mechanism": "Firms with higher earnings consistency and lower debt issuance are expected to perform better in low volatility market conditions due to their stable business model and lower financial risk.",
    "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "EarningsConsistency"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "DebtIssuance"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true},
    "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "ROE", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}],
    "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.95,
    "expected_decay_half_life_months": 60
  },
  {
    "name": "H8",
    "mechanism": "Firms with high idiosyncratic risk and high institutional ownership are expected to underperform in poor market conditions due to a risk-off sentiment among institutional investors.",
    "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "IdioVol3F"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "IO_ShortInterest"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "vol_target": true},
    "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}],
    "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8,
    "expected_decay_half_life_months": 42
  }
]}
